summary: All five Round-1 findings were accepted by Round 2; the revised PRD applies the major revisions cleanly. F1 (D.X collision) is fully dissolved by renaming cycle steps to non-numbered prose labels and preserving lane numbering. F2 (chain-don't-absorb) is mirrored from 029 via templates/admin/tdd-discipline.md + one-paragraph CORE_PRINCIPLES + one-line skill citations. F3 (stub broadcast) is moved to admin/scratch/{NNN-slug}-develop/ scratch territory with codex-r1-f2 narrowing schema ownership. F5 (R11 hard-block) is demoted to documented-discipline + manifest-outcome with fixture-anchored AC. F4 (blast radius) is mostly addressed by the new Vision paragraph but should sharpen to add the eval-field and per-task pre-implementation test runner surface (R13 + R14) — these are runtime costs the current blast-radius note doesn't enumerate. Net: 4 accept, 1 sharpen (no blocks). The PRD is structurally ready for Gate 2 close pending the f4 amendment.
